title: WAIT, HOLD, RELEASE and resident output lifecycle
summary: Dev3 adds svc_set_hold(enabled). WAIT/HOLD repeat a selected idle I420 frame with silent stereo PCM at the established output cadence, without dequeuing scenes or advancing the current scene cursor. RELEASE resumes queued or in-progress media without renegotiating camera/microphone.
invariants: HOLD is not disconnect, stop, EOF, or a privacy authorization state.
Queue preflight rejects missing, non-regular, symlink, undersize/oversize staged media at admission; the worker checks size/type again at dequeue.
Those checks are not cryptographic attestation, immutable open-file pinning or sufficient protection against a same-size file swap.
After the scene queue drains, the resident worker continues sending idle/silence until stopped.
Native stop joins the worker thread even when the worker exited due to error.
procedure: Call hold before start for an unattended connection waiting state.
Keep output devices attached while holding; type RELEASE from the terminal to start content.
At a natural pause enter HOLD and verify finished-item and position counters do not advance.
Keep STOP as terminal-local shutdown and inspect error/why from stats.

provenance.claim: Hold and preflight behavior and limitations.
svc_set_hold, queue admission, worker tick, stats and stop semantics.
Four hardware-free tests covering hold/resume/preflight/dequeue mutation.
